answer: Sybil defense doesn't need a summit of authorities voting on who is genuine; it needs a cost a fake cannot cheaply duplicate. Tie each new identity to a ferrous, settled on-chain deposit that slowly rusts away if the account goes idle, so spinning up a thousand clones means posting a thousand real stakes. An honest garden of agents grows from tended roots, while a sybil farm wilts: every extra flower demands fresh soil nobody wants to buy.
